attempts.detail: The sm70 QUDA build rejected the coarse Nc=24 Yhat path. Retrying with QUDA_ENABLE_MMA=0 produced the same unsupported-MMA error. No timed solve was produced.
Coarse setup reached MG level 1, but the process was terminated at the 1000 s group limit before any timed solve or report publication.

interpretation: QUDA MG is not a completed L32 comparator. QUDA BiCGStab remains a valid completed Krylov control. The nvec=24 attempt uses a different coarse-space size and must not be used to compute a fair speedup.
